title: 第四十八章 妥当吗第四十七章 我信你个鬼
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 季南北却只是摇头。
“师尊，您相信弟子便好。”
话都说到这个份上，程灵儿还能多说什么?
她总不能直说:我信你个鬼!
“也罢，那为师......便拭目以待了。”
程灵儿摆了摆手，只当是顺着自家徒弟的心意，哄他一句罢了。
又跟师尊嬉笑闲谈了一阵，季南北便行礼告退了。
虽说师尊的模样着实惹人怜爱，但不可久久凝视。
凝视师尊过久......恐生“冲师”之念啊。他唤出系统界面，目光投向新近显现的三种天赋选项。
天赋[金丹道体]:兑换需三百万魔道点。
天赋【纳元灵体】:兑换需一百五十万魔道点。
天赋【九转丹身】:兑换需三千万魔道点。
季南北不由得倒吸一口凉气。
“真不愧是只存在于传说中的体质，直接把兑换天赋的价格上限给刷新
季南北暗自咂舌。
如此算来，即便是按千分之一计，屏蔽那【九转丹身】天赋一个时辰，也需足足三万点魔道点!
这简直就是在烧魔道点啊!季南北轻叹一声。
魔道点这东西，果然是怎么都不够用。
除此之外，另一个让他颇为心动的，便是标价三百万的【金丹道体】了。
必定凝聚特殊金丹，且在金丹期及以上境界时战力翻倍。
这天赋妥妥是数据层面的“怪物“，就是字面意义上的强横无匹!
“得加紧完成讨伐任务，赚取魔道点了，争取在自身踏入金丹期之前，把这天赋兑换到手。”
季南北心中盘算着。
既然已寻得解决思路，季南北反倒不急于立刻去处理那位“暴躁少女”的事了。
暂且“放置“一段时间，让那位姑娘自己好好冷静一番，日后再去上演“拯救”戏码也不迟。
况且，即便季南北此刻想过去，也是办不到的，那七十二个时辰的“冷却期”还未结束呢。
于是，日程又轮转至前往后山“打野”的环节。
时光流转，次日清晨，季南北却并未第一时间启动寄魂。
今日，已是预定启程的日子。
季南北并无多少行李需要收拾，他的物品大多源自系统，自然也全都存放在系统空间之内。
走出房门，季南北立刻便看见，那位倚靠着红缨长枪的林梦夕师姐。
不得不说，在清晨缕缕曦光的映照下，背靠红缨枪而立的师姐，确实显得英姿飒爽，浑身洋溢着蓬勃的青春气息。
说起来，季南北至今仍不清楚自己这位师姐的具体年岁，修为又是几何。
以季南北当前的境界无法看透，这意味着林梦夕至少拥有金丹期以上的修为。
金丹期可驻颜不老，师姐显然也已过了能参与年轻一辈比斗的年龄上限，真实年纪还真不好估测。
亲口去问?
那简直是自讨没趣。
尽管外表是英气勃发的少女模样，然而“屑师姐”终究是“屑师姐”，这一点绝不会改变。
“总算出来啦，这就好，咱们动身吧!“
content_en:
Ji Nanbei just shook his head.
"Master, just trust me."
Having said that, what else can Cheng Linger say?
She can't just say: I believe you are a ghost!
"Forget it, as a teacher... we will wait and see."
Cheng Ling'er waved his hand, just thinking that he was following his apprentice's wishes and coaxing him.
After joking and chatting with the master for a while, Ji Nanbei bowed and left.
Although Master's appearance is indeed endearing, one should not stare at him for a long time.
If you stare at Master for too long... you may have the thought of "hating against Master". He called up the system interface and looked at the three newly revealed talent options.
Talent [Jindan Dao Body]: Three million magic points are required for redemption.
Talent [Nayuan Spirit Body]: Redemption requires 1.5 million magic points.
Talent [Nine-turn elixir]: 30 million magic points are required to redeem it.
Ji Nanbei couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.
"It is indeed a physique that only exists in legends. It directly refreshes the price limit of redeeming talents.
Already..."
Ji Nanbei secretly clicked his tongue.
Calculated in this way, even if it is calculated as one thousandth of a thousand, it would take a full 30,000 magic points to block the [Nine Turns of Alchemy] talent for an hour!
This is simply burning the magic point! Ji Nanbei sighed softly.
The magic way to click on this thing is indeed not enough.
In addition, another thing that made him very excited was the [Golden Elixir Dao Body] with a price tag of three million.
The special golden elixir must be condensed, and the combat power will be doubled at the golden elixir stage and above.
This talent is truly a "monster" at the data level, it is unparalleled in the literal sense!
"You have to hurry up and complete the crusade mission to earn magic points. Try to redeem this talent before you enter the golden elixir stage."
Ji Nanbei was thinking about it.
Now that he has found a solution, Ji Nanbei is not in a hurry to deal with the "irritable girl" immediately.
Let's "leave it aside" for a while and let the girl calm down. It won't be too late to stage a "rescue" drama in the future.
Moreover, even if Ji Nanbei wanted to go through it now, he couldn't do it. The seventy-two-hour "cooling off period" was not over yet.
So, the schedule turned to the "fielding" part of the back mountain.
Time passed, and in the early morning of the next day, Ji Nanbei did not activate the soul transfer immediately.
Today is the scheduled departure day.
Ji Nanbei didn't have much luggage to pack. Most of his belongings came from the system, so naturally they were all stored in the system space.
When Ji Nanbei walked out of the room, he immediately saw Senior Sister Lin Mengxi leaning on the red tassel spear.
It has to be said that under the rays of light in the morning, the senior sister standing with the red tassel gun on her back does indeed look heroic, and her whole body is filled with a vigorous youthful atmosphere.
Speaking of which, Ji Nanbei still doesn't know the specific age of his senior sister and her level of cultivation.
Ji Nanbei's current state cannot be seen through, which means that Lin Mengxi has at least a cultivation level above the Golden Core stage.
The golden elixir period can last forever, and the senior sister has obviously passed the upper limit of age for participating in competitions with the younger generation. It is really difficult to estimate her true age.
Ask in person?
That's just asking for trouble.
Although she looks like a dashing girl on the outside, "Senior Sister Chen" is still "Senior Sister Chen" after all, and this will never change.
"It's finally out, that's good, let's set off!"
